[agentlens cache-guard] reading Screen Shot.PNG into a ~120k-token session. An image block is RESIDENT: it rides forward in the prefix and is re-billed on EVERY later turn until a compaction evicts it — the cost is not the one read, it is the read times every turn that follows. Cheapest first: (1) delegate the look to a subagent — it reads the image in ITS small context and returns a text verdict, so nothing lands here; (2) if you look here, read every image you need in ONE message and draw the conclusions in that same turn — batching costs no more than one; (3) write the verdict down and never re-read the file. Silence: AGENTLENS_CACHE_GUARD=off.
